subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should Feishu support opt-in dynamic per-sender agents inside group chats, and if so should that live in the bundled Feishu plugin or as a separate ClawHub/plugin package?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior changes session identity, config writes, per-user memory/tool boundaries, group reply routing, and resource lifecycle policy; automation should not choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Design Opt-In Feishu Group Dynamic Agents
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-approved plugin-owned design that scopes group senders/topics, creates bounded agents, and proves isolation, lifecycle, and reply routing.

options.title: Document Existing Session Scopes Only
options.body: Treat group_sender and group_topic_sender as the supported group isolation surface and decline automatic per-sender agent creation in shared groups.

options.title: Move To External ClawHub Package
options.body: Ask contributors to prototype a Feishu group-agent orchestrator as a separately maintained plugin/package and only return to core if a missing SDK seam appears.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Feishu Group Dynamic Agents
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-approved plugin-owned design that scopes group senders/topics, creates bounded agents, and proves isolation, lifecycle, and reply routing.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history on Feishu group routing and Feishu subagent/session binding.
